title: 6 cozy date ideas you haven't tried yet

slides.title: 6 cozy date ideas you haven’t *tried yet*
slides.sub: No reservations. No dress code. Just the two of you.

slides.title: Blanket fort *movie marathon*
slides.body: Pick a trilogy, build the fort, phones stay outside.

slides.title: Candlelit *cook-off*
slides.body: Same ingredients, 45 minutes. The loser does the dishes.

slides.title: Coffee *crawl*
slides.body: Three cafés, one rating sheet, crown a winner.

slides.title: Sunset walk *and a flask*
slides.body: The cheapest good date there is.

slides.title: Bake something *new*
slides.body: Bonus points if it’s a disaster you’ll laugh about for years.

slides.title: Playlist *swap night*
slides.body: Dim lights, three songs each, and tell them why you picked them.

slides.title: Save this *for this weekend.*
slides.sub: Then send it to the one who always says “you pick.”
